import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import math
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from financial_agent.harness.market_calendar import session
from financial_agent.quant.backtest import BacktestConfig, run_backtest, performance_summary
from financial_agent.quant.data import CachedProvider, YahooProvider
from financial_agent.quant.strategies import build_strategy
from financial_agent.quant.strategies.research import ResearchForecastStrategy
from financial_agent.quant.validation import evaluate_promotion, PromotionPolicy

root = 'agents/equity/output'
strategy = ResearchForecastStrategy(root)
first = min(f.run_date for f in strategy.forecasts)
start = first - dt.timedelta(days=365)
end = dt.date.fromisoformat(session(dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=1)).basis_date)
symbols = sorted({f.ticker for f in strategy.forecasts} | {'SPY'})
print('Loading adjusted Yahoo cache', len(symbols), start, end, flush=True)
data = CachedProvider(YahooProvider(), cache_dir='.cache/quant').fetch(symbols, start, end)
policy = PromotionPolicy.load()
grid = [dict(output_dir=root, kelly_fraction=k, max_weight=w)
        for k, w in itertools.product((.25, .5), (.05, .10))]
report = dict(
    generated_at=dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    requested_start=str(start), requested_end=str(end),
    data_start=str(data.sessions[0].date()), data_end=str(data.sessions[-1].date()),
    sessions=len(data.sessions), symbols=symbols, adjusted=data.adjusted,
    data_source=data.source, data_fingerprint=data.fingerprint(),
    first_forecast=str(first), last_forecast=str(max(f.run_date for f in strategy.forecasts)),
    packages_loaded=strategy.package_count, forecasts_accepted=strategy.forecast_count,
    skipped_reasons=dict(strategy.skipped_reasons),
    forecasts_with_historical_active_session=sum(any(f.run_date < d.date() <= f.target_date
                                                   for d in data.sessions) for f in strategy.forecasts),
    policy={k:v for k,v in asdict(policy).items() if not k.startswith('_')},
    grid=grid, runs={},
    package_manifest=[dict(path=str(p), sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
                      for p in sorted(Path(root).glob('*/15_predictions.json'))],
)
for cadence in ('weekly', 'daily'):
    config=BacktestConfig(rebalance=cadence)
    baseline=run_backtest(build_strategy('buy_and_hold'), data, config)
    result=run_backtest(strategy,data,config)
    active_start=pd.Timestamp(first)
    active=result.returns.loc[result.returns.index > active_start]
    spy=baseline.returns.reindex(active.index)
    used=set()
    decisions=set(result.trades['decision_session']) if len(result.trades) else set()
    for day in decisions:
        for symbol in symbols:
            candidates=[(i,f) for i,f in enumerate(strategy.forecasts)
                        if f.ticker==symbol and f.run_date < day.date() <= f.target_date]
            if candidates:
                latest=max(f.run_date for _,f in candidates)
                used.update(i for i,f in candidates if f.run_date==latest)
    print('Evaluating gate',cadence,flush=True)
    gate=evaluate_promotion('research_forecast', grid, data, config, policy)
    report['runs'][cadence]=dict(
        config=asdict(config), summary=result.summary(), spy_summary=baseline.summary(),
        research_span_start=str(active.index[0].date()),research_span_end=str(active.index[-1].date()),
        research_span_summary=performance_summary(active,benchmark=spy),
        research_span_spy_summary=performance_summary(spy),
        forecasts_at_executed_decisions=len(used),
        packages_at_executed_decisions=len({(strategy.forecasts[i].model,strategy.forecasts[i].run_date) for i in used}),
        skipped_trades=len(result.skipped_trades),
        gate=dict(passed=gate.passed,checks=[asdict(c) for c in gate.checks],
                  oos_summary=gate.oos_summary,diagnostics=gate.diagnostics,
                  selected_params=gate.selected_params),
    )

def clean(value):
    if isinstance(value,dict): return {k:clean(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)): return [clean(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value,float) and not math.isfinite(value): return None
    return value

report=clean(report)
report['reproduce_python']=Path('/tmp/research_report.py').read_text()
path=Path('reports/quant/research-forecast-validation.json');path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')

def num(v): return 'undefined' if v is None else f'{v:.6g}'
lines=['# Research forecast validation', '',
       f"Generated {report['generated_at']}. Adjusted Yahoo daily bars: {report['data_start']}–{report['data_end']} "
       f"({report['sessions']} sessions, {len(symbols)} symbols including SPY). Requested span: {start}–{end}; "
       'the end is the latest completed NYSE session, never an intraday bar.', '',
       f"Loaded {strategy.package_count} packages; accepted {strategy.forecast_count} forecasts; "
       f"{report['forecasts_with_historical_active_session']} have an active session in the fetched history. "
       f"Forecast vintages span {first}–{report['last_forecast']}. All eligible historical tickers were fetched, "
       'including forecasts now expired; selecting only currently unexpired names would bias history.', '',
       'Skipped reasons (records unless marked as packages):', '', '| Reason | Count |', '|---|---:|']
lines += [f'| {k} | {v} |' for k,v in sorted(strategy.skipped_reasons.items())]
lines += ['', 'Most recent active run date wins per ticker. Same-date forecasts average mu and sigma equally across models (within-model means) before sizing. '
          'Only run_date < decision_session <= target_date is eligible; a package date also bounds row dates from below. '
          'Mu and sigma are decimal returns over the same forecast horizon. We use fractional Kelly mu/sigma², '
          'clip each name, then scale gross exposure to one. Default type is explicit EQUITY_ALPHA; missing types '
          'are skipped rather than invented. No model or sleeve filter is applied; monitoring forecasts are included. '
          'Status, confidence, scores and entry prices are metadata, not hindsight selection inputs.', '',
          'The coordinator-approved warmup is one observed close to match the existing backtester; no price lookback '
          'is used. The default 5% cap reads equity policy risk.max_single_name_weight. Fills use next open, whole '
          'shares, 2 bps half-spread plus 3 bps slippage, zero commission and a 2% drift threshold. '
          'That threshold can leave small residual holdings after a target expires. Cash earns zero. '
          'The data cache is gitignored under .cache/quant; no raw price data is committed.', '',
          '## Net performance versus SPY', '',
          'Full fetched history includes roughly one year of cash before the first forecast. The second span '
          'starts strictly after the first forecast date, with SPY returns on exactly the same sessions. '
          'Both summaries are descriptive in-sample evidence, not promotion evidence.', '',
          '| Cadence / span | Net return | SPY return | Sharpe | SPY Sharpe | Max drawdown | Costs ($) | Trades |',
          '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
notes=[]
for cadence,run in report['runs'].items():
    for span,key,bkey in [('full','summary','spy_summary'),('research','research_span_summary','research_span_spy_summary')]:
        a,b=run[key],run[bkey]
        lines.append(f"| {cadence} / {span} | {num(a['total_return'])} | {num(b['total_return'])} | "
                     f"{num(a['sharpe'])} | {num(b['sharpe'])} | {num(a['max_drawdown'])} | "
                     f"{num(run['summary']['total_costs'])} | {num(run['summary']['trade_count'])} |")
    notes += ['',f"{cadence.title()} research span: {run['research_span_start']}–{run['research_span_end']}. "
              f"{run['forecasts_at_executed_decisions']} forecast rows from {run['packages_at_executed_decisions']} "
              f"model/date vintages were active at executed decision dates; skipped fills: {run['skipped_trades']}.", '']
lines += notes
lines += ['## Unchanged promotion gate', '',
          'Predeclared grid: Kelly fraction {0.25, 0.5} × per-name cap {0.05, 0.10}. '
          'The packaged policy remains unchanged: 1260 train sessions, 252 test sessions, five-session embargo '
          'and at least 2520 OOS sessions. Undefined statistics are shown explicitly and fail closed.', '',
          '| Cadence | Check | Value | Threshold | Verdict |', '|---|---|---:|---:|---|']
for cadence,run in report['runs'].items():
    for c in run['gate']['checks']:
        lines.append(f"| {cadence} | {c['name']} | {num(c['value'])} | {num(c['threshold'])} | {'PASS' if c['passed'] else 'FAIL'} |")
lines += ['', 'Both cadences fail promotion. This short history cannot produce an OOS fold under the unchanged '
          'training window, and contains nowhere near ten years of OOS sessions. Net backtest performance does '
          'not establish a tradable edge. Continue collecting forecasts and independent outcomes; do not promote '
          'this strategy or relax the gate to accommodate the available sample.', '',
          'The companion JSON contains all checks and failure details, diagnostic PBO, the input manifest hashes, '
          'data fingerprint, configuration and generation code. Null means mathematically undefined, not zero. '
          'Ticker histories can be incomplete around listings; Yahoo adjustments and historical coverage can change. '
          'No missing bar is backfilled; the existing engine skips invalid execution prices and carries only prior marks.', '',
          '## Reproduce', '', '```sh',
          "uv run python - <<'PY'", "import json", "from pathlib import Path",
          "report = json.loads(Path('reports/quant/research-forecast-validation.json').read_text())",
          "Path('/tmp/research_report.py').write_text(report['reproduce_python'])", 'PY',
          'uv run python /tmp/research_report.py', '```', '',
          'Reproduction fetches through the latest completed session at execution time and overwrites the report. '
          'The committed snapshot records its own dates and hashes; later runs can differ.']
Path('reports/quant/research-forecast-validation.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print('Report saved',report['data_start'],report['data_end'],flush=True)
for cadence,run in report['runs'].items():
    print(cadence,'net return',run['summary']['total_return'],'passed',run['gate']['passed'],flush=True)
